about: Plain decode per stream (tokens a second, the server's timings) at `concurrency` streams decoding 256 tokens each from short prompts, --spec none --no-prefix-reuse, master 03afc418 (2026-10-28, choice-notes/lab/speed_model). The facts: the GGUF tensor tables (unsloth/Qwen3.5-9B-MTP-GGUF, unsloth/gemma-4-12b-it-GGUF) and the plan's. Long contexts (rows marked long: one stream decoding 513 tokens after 7K, 41K and 82K-token prompts, mdecl.sh, 2026-10-31; context = the prompt + 256, the decode's mean) of the same three files on eight cards, the GV100 among them.
